workbench_browser_address_placeholder: Placeholder of the browser tab address field; key is the shortcut that focuses it
workbench_browser_design_mode: Tooltip of the browser tab button that picks a page element to send to an agent
workbench_browser_empty_hint: Empty browser tab hint; key is the shortcut that focuses the address field
workbench_browser_failure_host: Browser tab error: the host name does not resolve
workbench_browser_failure_other: Browser tab error when the engine gave no message
workbench_browser_failure_refused: Browser tab error: the connection was refused
workbench_browser_failure_title: Heading of the browser tab error screen
workbench_browser_failure_tls: Browser tab error: TLS or certificate problem
workbench_browser_forward: Tooltip of the browser tab forward button
workbench_browser_open_in_browser: Button of the browser tab error screen
workbench_browser_open_in_system_browser: Tooltip of the browser tab button that opens the page in the system browser
workbench_browser_pick_hint: Banner while picking an element; key is Esc
workbench_browser_reload: Tooltip of the browser tab reload button
workbench_browser_with_screenshot: Browser tab: the picked element goes to the agent together with a screenshot
